entities.summary: Artyom Igorevich Umrikhin, better known as Artik, is a Ukrainian singer, director, producer, and composer. He is the recipient of "Pesnya goda 2011", as well as "Golden Gramophone 2011" for the music to the song "Отпусти" by GeeGun & Yulia Savicheva.
